passages.title: 명함 주문 확인 메일
passages.passage:
From: Print Express
To: Laura Bell
Subject: Order Confirmation #4471

Dear Ms. Bell,

Thank you for your order of 200 business cards. Your cards will be ready for pickup on Friday after 2 p.m. at our shop on Oak Street.

If you would like delivery to your office instead, reply to this email by Thursday noon. Delivery costs $4.

Best regards,
Print Express Customer Service

questions.q: What did Ms. Bell order?
questions.exKo: your order of 200 business cards에서 주문품이 명함임을 알 수 있습니다.
why: 'your order of 200 business cards'가 주문품을 명시
questions.ev: Thank you for your order of 200 business cards.

questions.q: When can the order be picked up?
questions.exKo: ready for pickup on Friday after 2 p.m.이라고 안내합니다.
why: 'ready for pickup on Friday after 2 p.m.'와 일치
목요일 정오는 배송 요청 회신 기한
오후 2시 이후이므로 금요일 오전은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: Your cards will be ready for pickup on Friday after 2 p.m. at our shop on Oak Street.

questions.q: What should Ms. Bell do to get delivery?
choices: Reply to the email by Thursday noon
Visit the shop on Oak Street
questions.exKo: 배송을 원하면 목요일 정오까지 회신하라고 되어 있습니다.
why: 'reply to this email by Thursday noon'이 배송 신청 방법
매장 방문은 픽업 방식이라 배송과 반대
4달러는 배송비지만 픽업 시 결제한다는 말 없음
questions.ev: If you would like delivery to your office instead, reply to this email by Thursday noon.

passages.title: 신입사원 환영 점심 초대 메일
passages.passage:
From: Kevin Moore
To: Sales Team
Subject: Welcome Lunch for Nina

Hi team,

Our new team member, Nina Torres, starts on Monday. To welcome her, we will have lunch together at Bella Pasta at noon on Tuesday. The company will pay for the meal.

Please reply by Friday so I can reserve a table. Let me know if you have any food allergies.

Thanks,
Kevin

questions.q: Why is the lunch being held?
choices: To welcome a new team member
questions.exKo: 새 팀원 Nina를 환영하기 위한 점심 자리입니다.
why: 'To welcome her'가 신입 환영이 목적임을 밝힘
questions.ev: To welcome her, we will have lunch together at Bella Pasta at noon on Tuesday.

questions.q: When will the lunch take place?
questions.exKo: at Bella Pasta at noon on Tuesday라고 명시되어 있습니다.
why: 'at noon on Tuesday'가 점심 시점을 그대로 제시
월요일은 Nina의 출근일이지 점심 날 아님
금요일은 회신 기한일 뿐 행사일 아님
questions.ev: we will have lunch together at Bella Pasta at noon on Tuesday

questions.q: Why should team members reply by Friday?
choices: So a table can be reserved
So the menu can be printed
questions.exKo: Please reply by Friday so I can reserve a table에서 이유를 알 수 있습니다.
why: 'so I can reserve a table'가 회신을 요청한 이유
Nina 소개는 회신 목적으로 언급되지 않음
회사 부담은 이미 정해진 사실이라 이유 아님
questions.ev: Please reply by Friday so I can reserve a table.

passages.title: 구내식당 메뉴 변경 공지
passages.passage:
CAFETERIA NOTICE

Starting next week, the staff cafeteria will offer a new salad bar every day. The soup station will move next to the window, and a vegetarian main dish will be added to the daily menu.

Lunch hours stay the same: 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. Menu cards are posted at the entrance each morning.

Cafeteria Services

questions.q: What is the notice mainly about?
questions.exKo: 샐러드바 신설 등 구내식당 메뉴 변경을 알리는 공지입니다.
why: 샐러드바 신설 등 식당 메뉴 변경이 공지 핵심
questions.ev: Starting next week, the staff cafeteria will offer a new salad bar every day.

questions.q: What will be added to the daily menu?
questions.exKo: a vegetarian main dish will be added라고 명시합니다.
why: 'a vegetarian main dish will be added'와 그대로 일치
questions.ev: a vegetarian main dish will be added to the daily menu

questions.q: What is indicated about lunch hours?
questions.exKo: Lunch hours stay the same에서 시간 변경이 없음을 알 수 있습니다.
why: 'stay the same'이 시간 변경 없음을 뜻함
더 일찍 시작한다는 말은 지문과 반대
시간 단축도 stay the same과 반대
questions.ev: Lunch hours stay the same: 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m.

passages.title: 사무실 재활용 규칙 공지
passages.passage:
RECYCLING REMINDER

Please use the correct bins in the break room. Blue bins are for paper only. Yellow bins are for plastic bottles and cans. Food waste goes in the green bin next to the sink.

Last month, many bins were mixed, and the building charged us an extra cleaning fee. Let's keep our office clean and avoid extra costs.

Office Administration

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To remind staff of recycling rules
questions.exKo: 분리수거함을 올바르게 사용하자는 재활용 규칙 안내입니다.
why: 'use the correct bins'가 분리수거 규칙 안내 목적
휴게실 이용 시간 변경 언급 없음
questions.ev: Please use the correct bins in the break room.

questions.q: What are the yellow bins for?
questions.exKo: Yellow bins are for plastic bottles and cans라고 되어 있습니다.
why: 'plastic bottles and cans'가 노란 통 용도와 일치
종이 전용은 파란 통이라 색이 다름
questions.ev: Yellow bins are for plastic bottles and cans.

questions.q: What happened last month?
choices: An extra cleaning fee was charged
questions.exKo: 쓰레기가 섞여 건물 측이 추가 청소비를 청구했다고 설명합니다.
why: 'charged us an extra cleaning fee'가 지난달 일
규칙은 새로 도입이 아니라 다시 알리는 것
questions.ev: Last month, many bins were mixed, and the building charged us an extra cleaning fee.

passages.title: 피트니스 센터 아침 회원권 광고
passages.passage:
EARLY BIRD SPECIAL — FIT ZONE GYM

Join Fit Zone this month and pay only $25 per month for our morning membership. Use the gym any day from 6 a.m. to 11 a.m., including weekends.

The price includes group classes, lockers, and towels. Sign up at the front desk or on our website. Offer ends June 30.

Start your day strong with Fit Zone!

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.exKo: 월 25달러의 아침 전용 회원권을 홍보하는 광고입니다.
why: 개인 레슨이 아니라 그룹 수업만 포함
주말 이용 가능일 뿐 스포츠 행사 아님
questions.ev: Join Fit Zone this month and pay only $25 per month for our morning membership.

questions.q: What is included in the price?
questions.exKo: includes group classes, lockers, and towels라고 명시합니다.
why: 'group classes, lockers, and towels'와 그대로 일치
questions.ev: The price includes group classes, lockers, and towels.

questions.q: When does the offer end?
choices: At the end of the year
questions.exKo: Offer ends June 30에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
questions.ev: Offer ends June 30.

passages.title: 이사 업체 봄 할인 광고
passages.passage:
MOVING THIS SPRING? CALL EASY MOVERS!

Book your move in March or April and get 15% off our standard rate. Our friendly team packs, moves, and unpacks your boxes safely.

We offer free boxes for moves within the city. Get a free price quote by phone or on our website in under five minutes.

Easy Movers — moving made simple since 2010.

questions.q: What service is being advertised?
questions.exKo: 이사 업체 Easy Movers의 봄 할인 광고입니다.
why: 짐을 싸고 옮기고 풀어주는 이사 업체 광고
무료 박스는 혜택일 뿐 박스 판매업체 아님
questions.ev: Our friendly team packs, moves, and unpacks your boxes safely.

questions.q: How can customers get 15% off?
choices: By booking in March or April
questions.exKo: Book your move in March or April and get 15% off라고 안내합니다.
why: 'Book your move in March or April'가 할인 조건
시내 이사는 무료 박스 조건이지 할인 조건 아님
questions.ev: Book your move in March or April and get 15% off our standard rate.

questions.q: What is offered for moves within the city?
questions.exKo: free boxes for moves within the city에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'free boxes for moves within the city'와 일치
짐 풀기는 기본 서비스일 뿐 시내 한정 혜택 아님
questions.ev: We offer free boxes for moves within the city.

passages.title: 주말 농산물 시장 개장 기사
passages.passage:
OAKDALE — A farmers market will open in Central Park every Saturday starting May 3. About 30 local farms will sell fresh vegetables, fruit, and cheese from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.

City officials hope the market will bring more visitors to downtown shops. Parking near the park will be free on market days. The market will run until the end of October.

questions.q: What is the article about?
questions.exKo: 5월 3일부터 매주 토요일 열리는 농산물 시장 소식입니다.
why: 매주 토요일 열리는 농산물 시장 개장이 기사 핵심
주차는 무료 제공이라 문제로 다뤄지지 않음
치즈는 판매 품목 중 하나일 뿐
questions.ev: A farmers market will open in Central Park every Saturday starting May 3.

questions.q: How many farms will take part?
questions.exKo: About 30 local farms will sell...에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
why: 'About 30 local farms'가 참여 농가 수를 명시
8은 시장 시작 시각이지 농가 수 아님
questions.ev: About 30 local farms will sell fresh vegetables, fruit, and cheese from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.

questions.q: What will be free on market days?
questions.exKo: Parking near the park will be free on market days라고 명시합니다.
why: 'Parking near the park will be free'와 일치
questions.ev: Parking near the park will be free on market days.

passages.title: 사무용품점 배달 로봇 도입 기사
passages.passage:
MILLBROOK — Office supply store Deskmart began using two small delivery robots this week. The robots carry orders to offices within one kilometer of the store.

Customers order online, and the robot arrives in about 25 minutes. A code sent to the customer's phone opens the lid. Store manager Rita Gomez said the robots help during busy hours, and delivery staff now handle only larger orders.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.exKo: 사무용품점이 배달 로봇 2대를 도입했다는 기사입니다.
why: 배달 로봇 2대 도입이 기사 전체 주제
온라인 주문일 뿐 새 앱 출시 언급 없음
questions.ev: Office supply store Deskmart began using two small delivery robots this week.

questions.q: How do customers open the robot's lid?
choices: With a code sent to their phone
With a key from the driver
questions.exKo: A code sent to the customer's phone opens the lid에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'A code sent to the customer's phone'이 개방 방법
questions.ev: A code sent to the customer's phone opens the lid.

questions.q: What do delivery staff do now?
questions.exKo: delivery staff now handle only larger orders라고 설명합니다.
why: 'handle only larger orders'가 현재 업무를 설명
questions.ev: delivery staff now handle only larger orders

passages.title: 우산 분실물 문의 문자
passages.passage:
Front Desk (10:05 A.M.)
Hello, this is the front desk. A blue umbrella was found in Meeting Room C. Is it yours?

Jake Woo (10:07 A.M.)
Yes! I was looking for it everywhere. Thank you!

Front Desk (10:08 A.M.)
Great. We'll keep it at the desk. You can pick it up anytime today.

Jake Woo (10:09 A.M.)
I'll come down at lunchtime. Thanks again!

questions.q: Why did the front desk send the message?
choices: To ask about a found umbrella
questions.exKo: 회의실에서 발견된 파란 우산의 주인을 찾는 메시지입니다.
why: 'Is it yours?'로 습득한 우산 주인을 확인함
회의실은 발견 장소일 뿐 일정 조율 아님
questions.ev: A blue umbrella was found in Meeting Room C. Is it yours?

questions.q: Where was the umbrella found?
questions.exKo: found in Meeting Room C에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'found in Meeting Room C'가 발견 장소
프런트는 보관 장소이지 발견 장소가 아님
questions.ev: A blue umbrella was found in Meeting Room C.

questions.q: When will Mr. Woo pick up the umbrella?
questions.exKo: I'll come down at lunchtime이라고 답합니다.
why: 'I'll come down at lunchtime'이 수령 시점
오늘 중 수령 가능하므로 내일 아침은 반대
questions.ev: I'll come down at lunchtime.

passages.title: 복사용지 재고 확인 문자
passages.passage:
Emma Ford (3:40 P.M.)
Hi Raj, do we have more copy paper? The cabinet on our floor is empty.

Raj Patel (3:42 P.M.)
There should be some in the storage room on the 3rd floor. Shelf B.

Emma Ford (3:45 P.M.)
Just checked — only two boxes left.

Raj Patel (3:46 P.M.)
Okay, take one and I'll order more today. It usually arrives in two days.

Emma Ford (3:47 P.M.)
Perfect, thanks!

questions.q: What is Ms. Ford looking for?
questions.exKo: 복사용지가 떨어져 재고를 찾고 있습니다.
why: 'do we have more copy paper'가 찾는 물품을 밝힘
빈 캐비닛은 상황 설명일 뿐 찾는 대상 아님
questions.ev: Hi Raj, do we have more copy paper?

questions.q: How many boxes are left in the storage room?
questions.exKo: only two boxes left라고 보고합니다.
why: 'only two boxes left'가 남은 수량을 명시
3은 창고가 있는 층수이지 상자 수 아님
비어 있는 것은 사무실 캐비닛이지 창고가 아님
questions.ev: Just checked — only two boxes left.

questions.q: What will Mr. Patel do today?
questions.exKo: I'll order more today에서 확인됩니다.
why: 'I'll order more today'가 오늘 할 일을 명시
questions.ev: Okay, take one and I'll order more today.
